ccf_discrepancy.note: Frontend CCF (ipc-contracts.jsonl col=121002) sends ONLY 'slots' — 'manager' key is absent from the frontend invocation. Backend evidence confirms Rust reads 'manager' (7B key from dispatcher) and 'slots' (5B key). Possible explanations: (a) 'manager' has a default/optional handling in backend not traced, (b) the observed CCF is from a different invocation pattern than the one that uses 'manager', (c) 'manager' is resolved server-side from session context. C5 consumer must clarify whether 'manager' must be passed explicitly.
